vb_textbox.text: Make sure that you keep focused on your screen and keyboard or else the time will run out quickly. After a few rounds, you will get used to the rhythm of selecting the relevant key and waiting for the gnomes and basket to appear on your screen.If you have collected 0 mushrooms on one round, I would then select the opposite gnome for the next round. For example, if you selected the gnome on the left side and it directed you to 0 mushrooms, I would then pick the right gnome for the next round.I tended to change whether I picked the left and right gnome every few game rounds.
